bundle.shortDescription: Open-source SSH workspace with encrypted credentials
bundle.longDescription: RuTerm is an open-source SSH client that keeps hosts, keys and settings in a single readable JSON vault, seals secrets locally, and syncs through your own credential-encrypted Cloudflare Worker + D1 bridge (which still sees host metadata) — or stays fully local.
